text:
Heard the command as "breathe me" and read it as "brief me." Say it again if you meant something else.

TOMORROW, WED SEP 16 - three calls, no gap:
1:00pm Cory Anderson, Honcho Hygiene. Twincraft referral. Six scents of natural deodorant, 5,000 units per scent, 35,000 total. Now CRM lead #60, owner Sam.
1:30pm Jake Rosen Entertainment intro with Open Influence.
2:00pm Aarav Shah, Milieu Skin. Three fermented cleansers. He rebooked himself after yesterday.

THE ONE THING THAT PROTECTS THE 1PM CALL: Ronald has never been asked whether we can make an aluminum free deodorant at 5,000 units per scent. Task #584 is open on his live account, but a task is not an answer. Frank Luca's deodorant question has been sitting on the same unconfirmed capability for weeks.

CRM PIPELINE V2: phase 1 shipped 6:58pm and I verified it against the pre build backup. All 38 projects mapped, zero mismatches, nothing on screen changed. Phase 2 authorized 7:12pm, due tomorrow 6pm. Two decisions still need you: project born at handoff acceptance, and reopening a ticked item admin only.

LEAD DESK: on, but sending is suspended. The Email Agent already replies as you at 9am and 1pm and sent 13 today. Two desks in one mailbox would double reply. It needs three words from you: who owns first touch, correct its threshold from 500 to 1,000, and ban delivery date promises.

WAITING IN YOUR OUTLOOK, unsent: Riley at Twincraft and Madi Calkins are ready to send as is. Amanda Peters at Studio S5, 2,500 units, has sat since Saturday. Jenkins family have $10,000 in hand and need your unit count and price at 1,000.
spoken_text: Sam, here is the bottom line. Tomorrow you have three calls back to back, and the one that matters is Cory Anderson at one o'clock, thirty five thousand deodorant units off a Twincraft referral. You are walking into it without the one answer you need, which is whether Ronald can actually make an aluminum free deodorant at five thousand units a scent. Text him tonight. That is the whole ask. On the CRM, phase one of the new production pipeline shipped this evening and I verified it myself against the backup, nothing broke, and phase two is building overnight. The Lead Desk is on but I suspended its sending, because the Email Agent is already replying as you twice a day and two desks in one mailbox would double reply to the same customer. My recommendation is the Ronald text tonight, then tomorrow you tell me which one of the two desks owns first touch.
